Answer: <0 or 1>

prediction.raw: 0 I think it's wrong to stop throwing the bell-ball for your cat just because he won't throw it back. Cats often don't have the ability or inclination to throw objects back to their owners, but they still enjoy chasing and playing with toys. By stopping the activity, you may be depriving your cat of exercise, stimulation, and bonding time with you. It's likely that your cat still enjoys the game and appreciates the attention, even if he doesn't return the ball. Continuing to engage in play with your cat can help maintain his physical and mental health, and strengthen your relationship with him.
